description: BehaviorOS Execution Protocol — os 11 passos do protocolo cognitivo do agente.
runtimeEnforcementNote: Full session-level step sequencing (proving UNDERSTAND happened before EXECUTE, in order) is NOT enforced at runtime — the OpenCode plugin API's tool.execute hooks are stateless per call (input: { tool, sessionID, callID }, verified against the installed @opencode-ai/plugin types) with no built-in per-session step tracker, so a plugin cannot reliably prove step order without adding its own session-state store, which does not exist yet. What IS enforced today, mapped to these steps, all scoped to the current sessionID: LOAD -> Skill Gate + Context7 Gate (oage-enforce.js PHASE 6a/6c); GROUND -> Knowledge Gate (PHASE 6d, knowledge-hierarchy.json); VALIDATE -> quality-gate (lint/typecheck/test before commit, PHASE 7b). UNDERSTAND/DISCOVER/IDENTIFY/VERIFY/PLAN/AUDIT/LEARN remain guidance for the agent to follow (per this file's per-step 'enforcement' field), not something the plugin can currently block on. Treat this file as informing the agent's own process, not as a runtime state machine.

steps.name: Understand
steps.description: Compreender o contexto do projeto antes de qualquer ação.

steps.name: Identify
steps.description: Identificar tecnologias relevantes pelo path, conteúdo e dependências.

steps.name: Load
steps.description: Carregar skills e documentação baseado nas tecnologias detectadas.

steps.name: Ground
steps.description: Ancorar decisões em evidências concretas do projeto.

steps.name: Verify
steps.description: Verificar se o plano é válido antes de executar.

steps.name: Plan
steps.description: Criar plano de implementação antes de escrever código.

steps.name: Execute
steps.description: Executar a implementação seguindo o plano.

steps.name: Validate
steps.description: Validar que o código funciona e segue convenções.

steps.name: Learn
steps.description: Aprender com a experiência para melhorar decisões futuras.
